content:
And then King of men Agamemnon replied to him:
'I rejoice, Laertiad, hearing your thoughts:
for you have stated everything appropriately and correctly.
About these things indeed I am willing to make an oath, and my heart urges me,
and I will not break the oath before the god. But Achilles
shall stay there, despite being eager for war:
and all you rest stay also, until the gifts
come forth from the tent and we make reliable oaths.
But I entrust this to you and command you:
having chosen the very best maidens of the Achaeans
bring the gifts from my ship, as much as we promised to Achilles
yesterday, and lead the women too.
But quickly, Talthybius, throughout the wide Achaean army,
prepare a boar to sacrifice to Zeus and Helios.
